title: RBI Penalty on United Puri-Nimapara Central Co-operative Bank - KYC Non-Compliance
description: <cite index="41-1">RBI imposed a penalty of ₹3 lakh on United Puri-Nimapara Central Co-operative Bank for failure to submit KYC records on time.</cite> <cite index="41-5,41-6">The penalty was imposed under Section 47A(1)(c) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, after the central bank found deficiencies in compliance with RBI's 'Know Your Customer (KYC)' guidelines.</cite>
